EGKB.notes: Biggin Hill Airport Ltd does its own handling (FBO + airport on one invoice). Source invoices SINV022016, 026852, 027121 (T7-ELL, GL6T 46 t), SINV024888 (T7-ALEX1, GLEX 43 t), SINV024668 and 025771 (T7-AFZ, GL7T 53 t), SINV026802 (A6-AFO, E35L). Fixed fees by weight class (GBP): E35L class landing 1,115 / international levy 190 / parking 25 per hour / handling 315; GLEX–GL6T class 1,820 / 263 / 42 / 495; GL7T 2,055 / 275 / 48 / 560. Sustainability levy 3.15 per ton (20 units on the AFO invoice), NATS approach 16.40. Parking: first 2 h free, then every started hour; after the first 24 billed hours 80% of the hourly rate (42 → 33.60, 48 → 38.40). On the T7-AFZ 10–25 August invoice (354 h) only 133 h parking charged (probably hangar); panel calculates the full stay. No invoice for ALX1·KBI (CL60) and FLH (GLF4), no prices entered. Toilet 130, belt loader 165. Waste disposal 52.50 per bag, dishes 50, ice 12, catering, laundry, crew/passenger transport not in comparison. No disbursement; VAT 20% only on transfers. Price list (George Day e-mail, 24 Aug 2026, Ground Services): water 130, GPU 165 per hour, air start 725 and tug & driver 165 (pushback) in basket; airstairs 100, security escort 95, excess baggage 150 and de-icing callout 300 (+ 7.50 per litre) tick. PLS & Security Charge (flights under NASP, on top of handling) 225 up to 6 pax, 60 per pax from the 7th: tick under Airport fees (on no invoice). No extra charge for technical stops; VIP service free, passenger services included in handling. They do not assist with landing permits. Invoice BQH-253025 (N194MF G550 41.2 t, BAND K, EGGW–EGKB–OMAD, 15–19 Apr 2026): same as ALEX group prices; international levy not charged for a domestic arrival (untick 'in total' for domestic arrivals). Foil trays, cancelled transfer and booking fee not entered. JETEX (Jetex London Biggin Hill, FBO): Offer 5 from Jetex e-mail 4 Nov 2026 (comparison file "JETEXs vs Biggin Hill EGKB Comparisons – Revised – V4 Final"; GBP). Handling (published 515/570/625/695 → Offer 5) SNR1·ALX1·KBI·OWN·BVY·AFO 386, ALEX·FLH 428, ELL group 469, AFZ 521; landing 1,365 / 1,750 / 1,820 / 2,055; border levy 220 / 250 / 263 / 275; parking per day 487.50 / 663 / 897 / 838.50 (first 2 h free); sustainability levy 3.50 per ton; London approach (NERL) 17.40; security screening 650 per service or 75 per person, whichever is greater; ASU 700, GPU 155, tug & driver 200, toilet 130, water 180, waste 65 per bag, airside escort 125, airstairs 250, belt loader 200; disbursement 10% on all third-party charges (airport fees). The same file shows Biggin Hill prices: SNR1 group handling 315, landing 1,365, levy 220, parking 550 per day (25 per hour × 22 h); ALEX·FLH 495 / 1,750 / 250 / 924. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): JETEX added (FBO), all groups; Jetex landing and border levy as in Excel; Biggin Hill keeps invoice-based values (E35L 1,115 / 190, GL5T 1,820 / 263); missing Biggin Hill groups CL60 and GLF4 filled from the comparison file (CL60 315 / 1,365 / 220 / 25 per hour; GLF4 495 / 1,750 / 250 / 42 per hour; sustainability 3.15 per ton; other services as other groups); Jetex parking first 2 h free then per started 24 h; security screening as tick row like Biggin Hill. Biggin Hill disbursement 15% (comparison file) applies to third-party charges only (catering, transfers etc., not in panel); not applied to Biggin Hill's own airport fees, consistent with invoices (user decision 13 Nov 2026). USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): Excess Baggage row deleted; Category 1 Waste Disposal renamed Waste Disposal and moved to the basket (with qty, per bag); Security Escort moved to the basket. Waste Disposal row renamed Trash / Waste Removal (panel standard, 13 Nov 2026).

HEGN.notes: Hurghada Intl (HEGN), Egypt. AIP AD 2 HEGN (AIRAC 11 Oct 2026): operator Egyptian Airports Company; aerodrome, customs/immigration, handling, fuel and security H24; no de-icing, no hangar; landing permission from Ministry of Civil Aviation at least 8 h before EOBT; both runways closed every Friday 04:00–08:00 UTC for maintenance. TIGER AVIATION (TAS, tigeraviation.aero) quotation for Falcon Flight Support, GLT4 (GLF4) 34 t, 9 Nov 2026, USD, all local and governmental taxes included; GLF4 group only. Airport charges: landing day 95 / night 119 incl. 2 h parking (night difference 24 in Surcharge on night arrival, 18:00–06:00 on the safe side, user decision), parking 3rd–5th hour day 20 / night 25 per hour (25 entered, safe side), housing 139 per 24 h (over 5 h), trash 30 if used, follow-me 25 and fire cart 25 per use if used, police fund care 15 EGP per departing pax (paid in USD; 0.28 at 55.37 EGP/USD), international departure pax services 29.71 per departing pax, security procedures 2 per departing pax, API 1.99 per pax per leg, API filing 50 per flight. Ramp handling: basic charges 400 (incl. marshalling, chocks, crew bus for 60 min on ground), loading/off-loading 170 per leg. TAS: CA control 75, luggage handling 40 per leg (A/C under 40 t), supervision 150. On-request equipment (attached list): GPU 90 kVA 130 / 140 kVA 150 per hour (150 entered), ACU normal body 155/h, ASU 95, water 95, toilet 145, push back 145 (in basket); tick: fire cart 25, towing 188, pax steps 170/h, crew/VIP bus 30/leg, passenger bus 45/leg, cabin cleaning 60, visa 25, tractor 80/h, belt conveyor 130/h, skilled worker 40/h. Requested but unused equipment charged 50% (not entered, user decision). Disbursement 5% on total invoice excluding TAS services (supervision, CA control, luggage handling) in case of credit basis; applied on the safe side (user decision). ZAS (ZAS Aviation, Cairo) estimate 'FALCON FLIGHT SUPPORT_GLF4_HEGN' (9 Nov 2026; A6-FLH GLF4 34 t, flight AGI006, 1 departing pax; 1,496.54 USD): GLF4 group only. Landing night 119, housing 139 per 24 h after 5 h, basic ramp handling 400 (incl. marshalling, chocks), security charges 65 per flight, visa 30, crew ramp transportation 30 per leg, passenger bus 45 per leg, GPU 90 kVA 145/h, ASU 95, ACU 155/h, toilet 145, water 95 (if requested), follow-me 25 per leg, fire brigade 25 per leg, VIP lounge departure hall 45 per pax, special passport service – lounge 326, departure tax 35 per departing pax (in International Departure Pax Services row), API 1.99, ZAS supervision 120 (no disbursement). Disbursement 5% on all items except supervision as calculated on the estimate (terms say 3% on 3rd party charges; 5% kept, user decision). User decisions: landing day 95 + night difference 24 and parking 3rd–5th hour 25/h as airport tariff (Tiger), API both directions, follow-me default qty 2 (both handlers), crew bus / passenger bus / fire brigade remain tick items. Not quoted by ZAS ('—'): police fund, security procedures, API filing, CA control, loading/off-loading, luggage handling, push back, trash. AVIARY price list HEGN (GLF4 34 t, undated, received 10 Nov 2026): GLF4 group only. Basic ramp handling 400 (marshalling, chocks, one crew bus); CAA: landing day 95 / night 119 (first 2 h), parking 3rd–5th hour 20 per hour day and night, housing 139 (5–24 h), jetway 145 up to 2 h if used (tick); pax: airport departure tax 29, security procedures 2, police departure service tax 1 (in Police row) per departing pax, API 1.99 per pax per leg; other: loading 170 per service if used (entered in arrival and departure loading rows like Tiger, basket; user decision), airport police screening 21 per flight (airport fees), VIP car 30 and crew car 30 per leg (tick), crew visa 30, follow-me 25 and fire cart 25 per unit; AVIARY supervision 125, disbursement 5% on 3rd party invoices (all items excl. supervision). Not on list ('—'): GPU, ASU, ACU, toilet, water, push back, trash, VIP lounge, API filing, CA control, luggage handling, security charges. ENIGMA (Enigma Aviation Services) cost list HEGN (GLF4, MTOW 33,838 kg; undated, received 10 Nov 2026): GLF4 group only. Basic handling turnaround 887.20 (toilet and water included, per user), ferry 776.30 (tick, replaces turnaround); pax: international departure pax tax 28.33, police departure pax fee 0.60, security tax 2, CUTE 1.00 per departing pax, API 1.99 arrival and departure; GSE: crew ramp transfer 30 and pax ramp transfer 45 per leg, start-up communication 45, fire cart 25 (tick), follow-me 21 per service (qty 2), GPU 90 kVA 130 per 60 min, security service 20 per flight (Security Charges row), push back narrow body 115 + 25% airport tax = 143.75; Enigma supervision 150, landing permit free. Airport fees: landing day 94.52 / night 118.32 (night difference 23.80), parking first 2 h free, day 10.70 / night 13.37 per hour (13.37 entered, safe side), housing 138.61 per 24 h (over 5 h, CAA rule). No disbursement stated (0). Not on list ('—'): ACU, ASU, trash, loading, VIP lounge, CA control, API filing, airport police screening. ENIGMA revised cost list (received 10 Nov 2026, used as basis per user): basic handling 400 per flight (no ferry rate; ferry row removed), toilet 145 and water 95 per service (no longer included), VIP microbus up to 10 pax 30 per leg (Passenger Bus row, replaces pax ramp transfer 45); other items unchanged. AVIARY extra equipment & activities price list (Egyptian airports incl. HRG, scale dated 01/01/2020; received 10 Nov 2026) and email 10 Nov 2026: GPU 90 kVA 130 / 140 kVA 150 per hour, ACU 155 / 185 per hour, ASU 95 / 145, water 95, toilet 145, push back 115 normal / 150 wide + 25% airport tax, towing 150 (up to 100 t) / 170 + 25% airport tax, pax steps 170 per hour, tractor 80, belt 130 per hour, skilled worker 40, cabin cleaning 60 / 100 / 145, pax bus 45, VIP / crew microbus 30, marshalling 30 and chocks 40 (included in AVIARY basic handling), dispatching 45 (not entered); VIP lounge at the departure hall 45 per pax; immigration for pax and crew on board 300 per leg (tick), at the VIP lounge 200 per leg (lounge row 400 per flight), customs service 50 per leg (tick). LIEO.notes: SKY SERVICES (Olbia), EUR, invoices to Falcon Flight Support. Source: invoice 1.138 (30 Jun 2026; P4-OWN E135 25 t, LSGG–LIEO–LYBA, 27.06 18:30 – 28.06 15:00 local, 'parking hrs 18', 6 adults + 2 children). Airport fees 1,217.03: landing and departure separately, 7.38 per ton (25 t × 7.38 = 184.50; June). Pax fees adult 53.98, child 50% 26.99; security 21.88, security bag charge 12.11, additional pax fees 10 (per pax incl. children); direction not on invoice, entered per departing pax (user; check with other invoices). Parking 118.25 for 18 h (6.57 per h). Commissione (administrative fee) 3.5% of airport fees → disbursement 3.5% airport. Handling services: standard handling 721.01 (OWN only), dedicated Sky agent 3 h 250 (supervision, in basket), disbursement fee 210, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, waste disposal 16 in basket (all groups); over 6 hrs stay (day time or night stop) 60, automatic when stay exceeds 6 h, in basket. Catering, dish washing, storage, ice not entered. SECOND INVOICE 1.684 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LOWG–LIEO–LTBA, 24.07 21:11 – 25.07 15:02 local, 'parking hrs 16', 7 adults): landing = departure 360.64 (10.607 per t); pax fee 63.51, security 25.75, security bag 14.25 (all 17.65% higher than 1.138; may be a July tariff increase), additional 10; parking 109.82 (16 h × 6.86); administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling overnight 1,052.30 + extra EU surcharge 154.48 (14.68%); lavatory cleaning 215; terminal operating extension 400; folder meteo 96; disbursement fee 395; agent 250; over 6 hrs 60; invoice processing 10; supplier stamp 2 + stamp duty 2 (Italian 'bolli': 2 € stamp duty on VAT-free invoices); taxi 15, storage, dish washing, laundry, catering not entered; 22% VAT on administrative fee (panel excl. VAT). USER DECISIONS (safe side, to be reassessed with other invoices): landing and departure July tariff 10.607 per t (started ton) for all groups; pax fees July amounts (child 31.76); parking first 2 h free (1.138: 20.5 h stay → 18 h, 1.684: 17.85 h → 16 h), then every started hour ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 6.86, ALEX 8.47, ELL 9.28, AFZ 10.69 (by ton ratio); FLH handling 1,052.30; disbursement fee 395 in all groups (no rate found for 210 / 395: airport fees, handling, catering, total tried; may be weight band or tariff increase); lavatory 215 in basket; stamp duty 2 under airport fees, without administrative fee (user); extra EU surcharge (14.68% of handling; not charged on 1.138 LSGG→LYBA, rule unclear) in Surcharge; terminal operating extension 400 and folder meteo 96 tick. THIRD INVOICE 1.395 (15 Jul 2026; A6-AFC GLEX 46 t, TAXI flight, OMDW–LIEO–LIRA, 03.07 18:10 – 04.07 16:20 local, 'parking hrs 20', no pax): landing = departure 276.08 (6.00 per t, possibly TAXI tariff), parking 20 h × 13.80 = 276, administrative fee 3% (24.84), standard handling 1,516.85, push back 2 × 250, lavatory 215, waste disposal intra EU 2 × 95, disbursement fee 358, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 410; laundry, storage, dish washing not entered. USER DECISIONS: ELL handling 1,516.85; parking ALEX and ELL 13.80 per hour, AFZ 15.90 (safe side); landing/departure kept at private tariff 10.61 per t (safe side); administrative fee 3.5%, disbursement fee 395 kept; push back 250 per movement tick with qty; waste disposal unit 95 with qty in basket; limousine 410 tick (bottom section); extra EU surcharge as handler row in Surcharge section (extraSc 14.68%, with 'apply'); supplier stamp and terminal operating extension under airport fees, without administrative fee (not in the 3.5% base on invoice); terminal operating extension tick (if extension occurs). By user decision: disbursement fee (395) as flat fee in Disbursement row (prices[type].disbFlat; shown as 'fee 395' with 3.5% administrative fee); invoice processing 10 tick (bottom section); push back in basket (with qty, default 1). FOURTH INVOICE 1.678 (31 Jul 2026; A6-FLH G450 34 t, LIRA–LIEO–LOWG, 21.07 12:49 – 24.07 12:46 local, 'parking hrs 70', 3 adults, intra-EU departure): parking 70 h × 9.28 = 649.74 (6.86 for a 16 h stay → hourly rate rises with long stays); intra-EU departure pax fee 48.84 and additional pax fee 6.50 (extra-EU 63.51 / 10; panel uses the higher), security 25.75 and bag 14.25 same; landing/departure 360.64; administrative fee 3.5%; standard handling 1,029.86; push back / tow bar 2 × 180 (G450; GLEX 250, panel 250); folder meteo 58.20; disbursement fee 379.50; agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, invoice processing 10, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; storage 180, dish washing, laundry 443, taxi reservation, catering, limousine 195 not entered. By user decision parking to the safe side: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 9.29 per hour; ALEX and ELL 18.68, AFZ 21.53 (with ratio 9.28 / 6.86 = 1.353). FIFTH INVOICE 1.613 (30 Jul 2026; A6-FLH, LFPB–LIEO–LIRI, 25.07, cancelled trip): only 'dedicated Sky agent one hour late CXX fee' 150 + stamp duty 2 = 152. By user decision tick row 'Late Cancellation Fee - Dedicated Sky Agent (1 h)' 150 in bottom section, all groups. SIXTH INVOICE 1.758 (5 Aug 2026; T7-AFZ GL7T 53 t, EGGW–LIEO–LFMN, 30.07 19:35 – 31.07 08:35 local, 'parking hrs 11', 1 adult, intra-EU departure): landing = departure 663.88 (12.53 per t), parking 11 h × 13.68 = 150.52, intra-EU pax fees, administrative fee 3.5%, standard handling 1,747.68, terminal operating extension 550, waste disposal extra EU 190, push back 2 × 250, disbursement fee 461, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2; no extra EU surcharge (arrival from outside EU, departure intra-EU); limousine dispo 1,267.50 and crew 201.50, ice, catering, dish washing not entered. By user decision: AFZ handling 1,747.68, AFZ landing/departure 663.88; ALEX 488.32 and ELL 552.16 (linear between 34 t 360.64 and 53 t 663.88, safe side); waste disposal unit 190 (extra EU). CONTRACT (Sky Service handling agreement, article 5): 5.1 10% discount on standard handling (at article 2.1 airports; no discount on LIEO invoices — no discount in panel by user decision). 5.3.1 airport fee payment service at FBO airports (LIML/LIMC/LIPZ/LIPH/LIPX/LIRA/LIRN/LIRI/LIBD/LIBR): up to 300 € 7.95, 300–1,000 € 3%, over 1,000 € 3.5% — exactly the 'Commissione' on LIEO invoices (828.16 → 3% on 1.395). 5.3.2 at non-FBO airports 10% of third-party invoices — LIEO 'disbursement fee' 210 / 395 / 358 / 379.50 / 461 does not fit consistently (1.678 and 1.758 about 10%; 1.684 and 1.395 clearly higher, 1.138 lower; base unknown). By user decision flat fee removed in panel, disbursement 13.5% on airport fees (3.5% administrative + 10% disbursement fee); also applied to limousine (forceDisb). The 10% share charged on catering/laundry/limousine is deducted from the invoice together with catering in comparisons. Terminal operating extension 550 (user; appears linked to movements outside terminal hours, not stay: 1.684 21:11 arrival 400, 1.758 19:35 arrival / 08:35 departure 550). To ask Sky Services: disbursement fee base, administrative fee + disbursement fee on the same invoice, 10% handling discount. SEVENTH INVOICE 965 (16 Jun 2026; P4-BVY E135 25 t, LLBG–LIEO–OMDW, 08.06 03:45 – 11.06 17:47 local, 'parking hrs 84', no pax): landing/departure 184.50, parking 84 h 379.50 (4.52 per h), administrative fee 3% (748.50), standard handling overnight 831.50, terminal operating extension 2,800 (03:45 night arrival), lavatory 215, push back and towing 1 × 360, disbursement fee 496, invoice processing 10, agent 250, over 6 hrs 60, supplier stamp 2, stamp duty 2, limousine 461.50. Handling: day 'standard handling' appears banded per ton (OWN 721.01 = 28.84 per t, FLH 1,029.86 = 30.29 per t, ELL 1,516.85 and AFZ 1,747.68 = 32.975 per t); 'standard handling overnight' with night movement OWN 831.50 (+15.3%), FLH 1,052.30 (+2.2%). By user decision handling at day price (OWN 721.01, FLH 1,029.86, ELL 1,516.85, AFZ 1,747.68), night difference in Surcharge as handler 'night' 15.4%, 21:00–06:00 (highest rate seen, so panel is not lower). Extra EU surcharge 15% on day handling (1,029.86 × 15% = 154.48, exact with invoice). Push back / towing one row per flight in basket: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 360; ALEX, ELL, AFZ 500. Terminal operating extension unit 550, with qty (1 unit per started hour outside operating hours; 6 units ≥ 2,800 on 965), in disbursement base (13.5%). Parking 4.52 per h (84 h) — panel kept at 9.29. ALEX group handling by user decision 42 t × 32.975 = 1,384.95 (ELL and AFZ per-ton rate; no invoice). By user decision (correction after 965): ALX1·KBI and OWN parking 6.57 per hour (OWN invoices 6.57 / 4.52); terminal operating extension per hour, with qty: ALX1·KBI, OWN, FLH 400 (1.684 1 h 400, 965 7 h 2,800), ALEX, ELL, AFZ 550 (1.758). AVIAVIP (Argos VIP Private Handling, Rome) invoice 526100890 (31 Oct 2026; A6-FLH GLF4 33.59 t, OMDW–LIEO–LEMD, 7 Oct 12:47–14:08 UTC, 6 + 0 pax, commercial; EUR, no VAT): handling 2,037.96, service terminal 110, coordination 75, dedicated agent 150, pax assistance 85, fuel arrangement 30 (not entered), marshalling 75, permit 100, tarmac 6 × 12, porterage 8 × 14, duty stamp 2, credit administration fee 75, environmental fee 40, extra EU organic waste 2 × 130; airport fees 308.54 (landing 153.27, take off 153.27, parking 0, duty stamp 2) + 20% disbursement 61.70. USER DECISIONS (6 Nov 2026): AviaVIP separate handler, FLH only; disbursement 20% airport; items in basket (dedicated agent as supervision; tarmac 12 per arriving and departing pax; porterage 14 per bag with qty box; extra EU organic waste 130, default 2); landing and take-off at AviaVIP with its own invoice value 153.27 (Sky 360.64 from its own invoices; conflict noted); other airport rows same as Sky; fuel arrangement not entered.

OAMS.notes: Mazar-i-Sharif (OAMS / MZR), Afghanistan, USD. Sources: Afghanistan Civil Aviation Authority fees regulation (international: ATC 150 arrival + 150 departure, landing 10 per ton (MTOW), parking first 4 h free then every 24 h 4 per ton, lighting sunrise–sunset 60 / sunset–sunrise 60, aviation security 500 per flight, cargo security 100; domestic: no ATC, landing 3 per ton, parking 1.5 per ton, lighting 20, security 200; departing pax tax table blank; children up to 2 years exempt) and SONIC JET quote (12 Nov 2026; CL-60 24.5 t, pax; "E35L" noted): landing 245 approx (min 100), parking 98 per day (first 4 h free), ATC 400, lighting 150 approx, departing pax tax 40; basic handling transit 1,700 / turnaround 2,100, technical stop 1,050 (incl. marshalling, pax steps up to 2 h, water/toilet on request, cargo breakdown, baggage equipment); GPU 700 per hour, ACU 1,200 per hour, push back conventional 500 / wide body 700 per use, labor 100, supervision & arrangement 400, supervision at night 500 (18:00–03:00 UTC), disbursement 10%, sales government tax 4%, admin/communication 35, landing permission / PPR 130; cargo handling of combined flights 60 per ton, reload 90 per ton, warehouse 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.10 per kg; cancellation 30% of handling < 12 h, 50% < 6 h before STA. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): handler SONIC JET; handling only in E35L group (quote group); airport fees by CAA per ton in all groups (22 / 24.5 / 34 / 42 / 46 / 53 t); ATC 400 and lighting 150 as on Sonic quote (CAA 300 / 60 per movement; to be compared when another handler quotes); aviation security 500 from CAA in basket (not on quote); turnaround 2,100 in basket, transit and technical stop as tick rows replacing it; supervision 400 + night difference 100 automatic (22:30–07:30 local); admin 35, PPR 130, ACU and push back in basket, GPU per hour, labor tick; disbursement 10% on airport fees; sales tax 4% not entered (tax); cargo, warehouse and cancellation not entered. BALKH AIR SERVICES ground handling charges sheet (undated, entered as 12 Nov 2026; USD; prices shown NB/WB = narrow body / wide body, valid for scheduled and non-scheduled flights): basic handling pax flight by MTOW 0–9.99 t 2,496, 10–24.99 t 3,168, 25–39.99 t 3,936, 40–79.99 t 4,320 (cargo 2,592 / 3,360 / 4,416 / 4,992; larger classes not relevant); NB: GPU 410 per hour, fresh water 200, wheelchair 25, additional toilet 200 (1 included), push back 350 per movement, towing 450 per leg, additional stairs 170 per hour, ACU 550 per hour, de-ice equipment 1,500, CUTE 110, DCS 110, meteo/flight ops file printing 80, ATS flight plan print 50, de-ice fluid 14 per litre, ASU 420 per bleed, LDL 400 / MDL 600 per hour, jack 80, forklift 100, cherry picker 170, catering transfer 300, crew bus 100 (1 included), cabin cleaning 250, cabin disinfection 70, hold disinfection 120, cabin dressing 150, hold cleaning 110, garbage 70, ambulift 150, headset 30 (1 included), conveyor 150 (1 included), pax bus 150 (1 included), offloading baggage 100 per pax, nitrogen 200. USER DECISIONS (13 Nov 2026): NB prices; all groups by MTOW; airport fees from CAA (ATC 300, lighting 60 per movement = 120, landing 10 per ton, parking ton × 4 per 24 h after 4 h, security 500) and departing pax tax 40 (Sonic; CAA table blank); no disbursement (not stated); handling, GPU per hour, ACU and push back in basket; other services tick; cargo and WB-only items not entered.

Payment: cash, card (crew before departure) or bank transfer. Handling by MTOW category (turnaround): 20–30 t 950, 30–40 t 1,000, 40–60 t 1,200; ALEX group by type rule GLEX (43.5 t, Category 4). Technical landing (fuel) half price. Basic handling valid for one turnaround (arrival + departure, at agreed times) and General Aviation Terminal only. If Presidential Terminal (Pavilion) or official lounge at commercial terminal is used, handling +50%: tick the row under Handling (government tax not applied separately to this difference). Included in handling: VIP parking stand, marshalling, VIP pax meeting, ramp supervision, customs/passport assistance, VIP lounge, crew lounge, baggage and one conveyor belt (Category 4 and above), light waste, fuel/catering/hotel/transfer arrangement, GD and manifest. Mandatory lounge/terminal fee per flight 350. Disbursement 10% (on airport and CAA fees, cost + 10% accounting surcharge). Government Tax 5% of handling; by user decision in basket, entered as fixed amount on basic handling (rises slightly if additional services included). Landing per ton 5 USD (min 67) + 1 USD stamp; by user decision same at both handlers with rounded ton from SLS invoices (CL60 111, E35L 121, FLH 171, ALEX group 211, ELL group 226, AFZ 261). Earlier exact MTOWs: ALX1·KBI 21.863, OWN 24.3, FLH 33.838, ALEX group 41.95, ELL group 45.13, AFZ 52.095 t. Parking: first 8 h free, then per ton per day 3 USD; by user decision same rule and tonnage at both handlers (rounded ton from SLS invoices, SLS parking interpretation below). Passenger embarkation tax at GAT per pax 100 (with departing pax). Immigration per movement 100 (06–18), 200 (18–06); night difference as separate row +100, automatic by time.
